plain_english_revision: The amendment exempts self-funded health plans governed by federal law (ERISA) from specific state regulations regarding patient steering and price discrimination found in Sections 27-45A-8 and 27-45A-10. It also modifies the definition of 'drug' to explicitly include specialty medications eligible for CMS tier placement, regardless of conflicting laws.
candidate_position_supported: The amendment advances a policy position that limits the application of new state pharmacy benefit manager regulations to self-funded plans governed by ERISA and clarifies statutory definitions regarding specialty drugs.
evidence_quotes: (a) On page 12, line 1, before "Nothing" insert the following: (b) The following provisions shall not apply to the administration by a person of any term, including prescription drug benefits, of a self-funded health benefit plan that is governed by the federal Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974...

On page 17, line 26, after "drug" insert the following: ...including each and every prescription medication that is eligible for specialty tier placement by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services pursuant to 42 C.F.R. § 423.560...
